description: fleet-hosted (#12583, component C of #9081): the hosted fleet front door — one Cloudflare Worker with route modules for the stamping, query, queue, ingestion and sync doors over one auth/tenancy plumbing layer. Real so far: RP-token auth validation, tenancy mapping, health/capabilities (#12583), the session registry (#12584), stamp signatures (#12586), and the stamping create path (#12585); the remaining doors are stubs their C issues fill. Local-only; no deployment.
name: fleet-hosted
